context: A small classroom show-and-tell. Sho stands at the front holding a rock he's very proud of. Asuka — visiting his class today — is patient and curious.
purpose: tiny classroom moment — shy kid given an audience by a teacher

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: しょうくん、その石、見せて？
lines.en: Sho-kun — can I see that rock?
lines.style: Crouches to his level. Voice warm, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Holds it out with both hands, careful. Eyes on the rock, not her.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: うわ、本当にきれい。どこで見つけたの？
lines.en: Wow — really pretty. Where did you find it?
lines.style: A real teacher-delight. Not exaggerated; genuine.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ええと…公園の池の近く。
lines.en: Um… by the pond at the park.
lines.style: A small voice gaining confidence as he speaks.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいところ知ってるね。これ、面白い色してる。
lines.en: You know good places. This one's got an interesting color.
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 「面白い」. Treats his find with respect.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 大切なやつ。家に、たくさんある。
lines.en: It's an important one. I've got lots at home.
lines.style: A proud full sentence — longest one all day.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: コレクター、すごいね。次、見せてくれる？
lines.en: A collector — that's impressive. Show me more next time?
lines.style: A small bow inside the voice. Invitation as compliment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A small unguarded line. Pleased — genuine and unforced throughout.
